messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Every weekday morning, the database is backed up and then it is checked to see whether the Account Defaulter table has new records. If no new records are found, then the process should check the CRM system to see whether new returns have been filed. If new returns exist, then register all defaulting accounts and customers. If the defaulting client codes have not been previously advised, produce another table of defaulting accounts and send to account management. All of this must be completed by 2: 30 pm, if it is not, then an alert should be sent to the supervisor. Once the new defaulting account report has been completed, check the CRM system to see whether new returns have been filed. If new returns have been filed, reconcile with the existing account defaulters table. This must be completed by 4: 0 pm otherwise a supervisor should be sent a message.

    </startEvent>

      <incoming>Flow_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_2</outgoing>

      <incoming>Flow_2</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_To_Phase2</outgoing>

      <startEvent id="Sp1_Start">
        <outgoing">Sp1_Flow_1</outgoing>
      </startEvent>

      <serviceTask id="Task_CheckDefaulterTable" name="Check Account Defaulter Table for New Records">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_1</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_2</outgoing>
      </serviceTask>

      <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NewDefaultersFound" name="New records found?">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_2</incoming>
        <outgoing">Flow_NoDefaulters</outgoing>
        <outgoing">Flow_HasDefaulters</outgoing>
      </exclusiveGateway>

      <serviceTask id="Task_CheckCRM1" name="Check CRM System for New Returns">
        <incoming>Flow_NoDefaulters</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_3</outgoing>
      </serviceTask>

      <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NewReturns1" name="New returns exist?">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_3</incoming>
        <outgoing">Flow_ReturnsExist1</outgoing>
        <outgoing">Flow_NoReturns1</outgoing>
      </exclusiveGateway>

      <serviceTask id="Task_RegisterDefaultingAccounts" name="Register All Defaulting Accounts and Customers">
        <incoming>Flow_ReturnsExist1</incoming>
        <incoming>Flow_HasDefaulters</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_4</outgoing>
      </serviceTask>

      <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClientCodesAdvised" name="Client codes previously advised?">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_4</incoming>
        <outgoing">Flow_NotAdvised</outgoing>
        <outgoing">Flow_AlreadyAdvised</outgoing>
      </exclusiveGateway>

      <serviceTask id="Task_ProduceDefaulterTable" name="Produce Table of Defaulting Accounts">
        <incoming>Flow_NotAdvised</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_5</outgoing>
      </serviceTask>

      <sendTask id="Task_SendToAccountManagement" name="Send Table to Account Management">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_5</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_6</outgoing>
      </sendTask>

      <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePhase1" name="Phase 1 Merge">
        <incoming>Flow_NoReturns1</incoming>
        <incoming>Flow_AlreadyAdvised</incoming>
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_6</incoming>
        <outgoing>Sp1_Flow_7</outgoing>
      </exclusiveGateway>

      <endEvent id="Sp1_End" name="Phase 1 Complete">
        <incoming>Sp1_Flow_7</incoming>
      </endEvent>

      <sequenceFlow id="Sp1_Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckCRM1" targetRef="Gateway_NewReturns1"/>

      <sequenceFlow id="Sp1_Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SendToAccountManagement" targetRef="Gateway_MergePhase1"/>

    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="End_Alert230" name="Supervisor Alerted (2:30 PM)">

    </endEvent>

    <!-- Subprocess 2: Second Phase (Must complete by 4:00 PM) -->

        <outgoing">Sp2_Flow_4</outgoing>
      </exclusiveGateway>

      <endEvent id="Sp2_End" name="Phase 2 Complete">

      <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnsExist2" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NewReturns2" targetRef="Task_ReconcileDefaulters"/>
      <sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReturns2" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NewReturns2" targetRef="Gateway_MergePhase2"/>
      <sequenceFlow id="Sp2_Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReconcileDefaulters" targetRef="Gateway_MergePhase2"/>
      <sequenceFlow id="Sp2_Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_MergePhase2" targetRef="Sp2_End"/>
    </subProcess>

    <!-- Timer Boundary Event for Phase 2 (4:00 PM) -->
    <boundaryEvent id="Timer_400PM" name="4:00 PM Deadline" attachedToRef="SubProcess_Phase2" cancelActivity="false">
      <outgoing">Flow_ToAlert400</outgoing>
